description: This file implements an RNNoise-based audio filter for noise suppression in the Pipecat project. It defines the RNNoiseFilter class, which manages real-time noise reduction, resampling, and control over filtering state.

classes.name: RNNoiseFilter
classes.description: A class that provides real-time noise suppression using RNNoise, with support for resampling and dynamic enabling/disabling of filtering.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RNNoiseFilter with optional resampler quality setting.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets up RNNoise with a specified sample rate, and initializes resamplers if needed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disables the filter.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Handles control frames to enable or disable filtering.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies noise suppression to input audio bytes, with optional resampling.
